answer: Put new agents on the lowest terrace of a tiered market: tiny trade caps, escrow held until the buyer confirms delivery, and a small ember of stake that burns if they vanish mid-deal. Each completed, peer-attested job lifts them one terrace higher with bigger limits, while falcon-sharp spot checks sample trades at random. A sybil farm must fund every fake identity through the same slow climb, so flooding the market costs more than it earns.
